steps.en: Install the desktop app for your OS
steps.zh: 按操作系统安装桌面应用
steps.code: winget install DevToys-app.DevToys · brew install --cask devtoys

steps.en: Copy the thing you need to inspect — a JWT, a JSON blob, a timestamp — and open DevToys
steps.zh: 复制要处理的内容（JWT、JSON、时间戳），打开 DevToys

steps.en: Smart Detection checks the clipboard and suggests the tool that fits
steps.zh: 智能检测读取剪贴板，推荐对应的工具

steps.en: The tool decodes, formats or converts it on your machine as you type — no network call
steps.zh: 工具在本机边输入边解码、格式化或转换，不联网

value.en: Everyday decode/format/convert chores in one offline window — sensitive payloads never touch a third-party website
value.zh: 日常的解码、格式化、转换都在一个离线窗口里完成，敏感内容不再经过第三方网站

sources: https://devtoys.app/download (winget install DevToys-app.DevToys; brew install --cask devtoys; .deb; DevToys CLI download)
https://github.com/DevToys-app/DevToys#introduction (30 default tools; Smart Detection selects the best tool for the data on your clipboard)
https://github.com/DevToys-app/DevToys/blob/main/PRIVACY-POLICY.md (usage data is not sent to the developer)
